title: History Says a $10,000 Investment in the QQQ Will Be Worth $66,000 in 10 Years
author: Neil Patel
description: The Invesco QQQ Trust ETF generated a 563% total return over the past decade, translating to a 20.8% annualized return. If this performance repeats, a $10,000 investment could grow to $66,000 in 10 years. The bull case depends on AI delivering on its promise and generating adequate returns on massive capital expenditures, while the bear case warns of decelerating growth and uncertain AI economic benefits.

title: Google, Amazon, and Meta All Just Raised Capex Guidance Again. This Boring Industrial Wins No Matter Whose AI Infrastructure Is Best.
author: James Brumley
description: Major tech companies (Google, Amazon, Meta) are significantly increasing AI infrastructure spending, which benefits not just chip makers like Nvidia, but also less obvious beneficiaries in power generation and uranium supply. Cameco, a uranium provider for nuclear power plants, is positioned to win long-term as AI data centers increasingly rely on nuclear power, though benefits may take years to materialize as new nuclear facilities are built.

title: Nvidia vs. Meta: Is Custom Silicon a Critical Threat to Nvidia's AI Moat?
author: Rick Orford
description: Nvidia and Meta are competing in the AI market from different angles. Nvidia controls the chips and software powering the AI boom, while Meta is developing custom hardware and open models to reduce Nvidia's dominance. Despite their rivalry, both companies could potentially win by dominating different layers of the market.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Nvidia maintains a strong position controlling AI chips and software, but faces emerging competitive threats from Meta's custom hardware development. The article presents both its current dominance and potential vulnerabilities.

Meta is actively challenging Nvidia's market control through custom hardware development and open-source AI models. The article suggests Meta could win by dominating a different layer of the market, indicating growth potential in the AI space.

title: Energy Transfer Just Raised Its 2026 Guidance. Is the Stock Still a Buy?
author: James Halley
description: Energy Transfer raised its 2026 EBITDA guidance by $500 million to $18.8-19.1 billion following strong Q2 results, with distributable cash flow up 32% year-over-year. The company continues expanding infrastructure for AI data centers and natural gas exports, raised its dividend for the 19th consecutive quarter, and trades at a modest 9.7x EV/EBITDA multiple. However, a 29% decline in natural gas prices since January poses a risk to volume growth if sustained.
